items.title: Claude in Microsoft Foundry and 365 Copilot
items.summary: Claude Sonnet 4.5, Haiku 4.5, and Opus 4.1 are now available in Microsoft Foundry, where Azure customers can build production applications and agents.

items.title: Microsoft, NVIDIA, and Anthropic partnerships
items.summary: Anthropic commits $30B to Azure compute as NVIDIA and Microsoft invest up to $15B combined, bringing Claude to all three major clouds.

items.title: Anthropic brings AI education to Africa with Rwanda and ALX
items.summary: A Claude-based learning companion reaches Rwandan teachers and 200,000+ ALX students across Africa.
